page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 Broadwell-generation processor. The instance provides 28 vCPUs derived from 14 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz with hyperthreading enabled. It is configured with 112 GB of system RAM, providing an even 4.0 GB of memory per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA Pascal architecture P100 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance also bundles a 472 GB local SSD and 5 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations reveal distinct performance trade-offs inherent to the older microarchitecture. Single-thread processing shows significant weaknesses, with stress-ng single-core performance landing in the bottom 10 percent and single-threaded gzip compression at 21.64 GB/sec placing in the bottom 25 percent. Multi-threaded workloads show solid mid-tier capabilities, producing 16,690.99 points in multi-core stress-ng tests and a PassMark CPU score of 19,899.23. The memory subsystem maintains standard throughput, registering uncached read speeds of 57.89 GB/sec and write speeds of 33.20 GB/sec.

The bundled NVIDIA P100 GPU demonstrates solid performance for specific inference tasks. In large language model benchmarks, the instance achieves top-tier results in prompt processing with 9,900.16 tokens per second on a small 135M model and 317.00 tokens per second on a medium 7B model. Medium model generation throughput reaches 42.95 tokens per second, also in the top tier. Conversely, generation on small models aligns with mid-tier results at 250.91 tokens per second. The 16 GB frame buffer restricts execution to smaller models, leaving 70B parameter tests unsupported.

From an efficiency perspective, the older CPU architecture limits effectiveness for high-performance single-thread CPU compute, but the pairing of 14 physical cores, 112 GB of host memory, and dedicated GPU compute creates a viable platform for legacy GPU applications. The instance fits deep learning inference pipelines, GPU-accelerated batch data processing, computer vision tasks, and moderate caching workloads like Redis, which recorded 19.05 million operations per second.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance featuring 28 vCPUs across 14 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 physical cores at 2.5 GHz, 112 GB of memory, and a 472 GB local SSD. It includes a single NVIDIA P100 accelerator with 16 GB of VRAM and provides 5 Gbps baseline networking. While single-thread CPU execution ranks in lower tiers due to its older x86_64 microarchitecture, multi-threaded CPU output and memory operations remain in average percentiles. The integrated Pascal GPU demonstrates strong performance in AI inference, scoring in the top tier for small and medium model prompt ingestion and medium model generation. This hardware profile suits GPU-assisted machine learning inference, computer vision processing, and parallelized data transformation workflows.
